description: Item (b) audit: canonical_a_k(jet-knot) values for A≥3 atoms (0.065/0.205/0.677 for ³H/³He/⁴He) capture a DIFFERENT physical quantity than what Strategy-3's t1_atom needs. The 70-84% binding-energy under-prediction reflects this structural mismatch, not an error in canonical_a_k itself.
